integrity: All cyclic classes exhaustively enumerated by a Python implementation and independently by a C++17 enumeration using a different canonical-root rule. Certificate of 336 maximum classes and source supplied. Mathematical validation independent of this manuscript has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete exact finite enumeration only for binary order seven, not all orders or alphabet sizes. Previously established maximum period 36 is prior work. Potential earlier unindexed enumeration remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Complete period spectrum and extremal rigidity of binary order-seven orientable necklaces
